```{r setup, include=FALSE}

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(report_label,'\n\n')
for (i in seq_along(report_sections)) {
  if (i %in% c(3,5,6)) cat('\\newpage\n\n')
  cat('## ',report_sections[[i]]$title,'\n\n',sep='')
  cat(report_sections[[i]]$paragraphs[1],'\n\n')
  if(i==5)cat(knitr::kable(method_rows),'\n\n')
  for(p in report_sections[[i]]$paragraphs[-1])cat(p,'\n\n')
}
```

The styled four-page print copy is built by `Rscript make_session_materials.R --day4`.
